hint.text: 1 centimetre is the same length as 10 millimetres.

instruction.text: Match the measurements given in centimetres and millimetres on the left to the measurements given just in millimetres on the right.

atoms.sound: 1 cm and 5 mm is as long as 15 mm.
8 cm and 1 mm is as long as 81 mm.
10 cm and 8 mm is as long as 108 mm.

hint.text: 1 metre is the same length as 100 centimetres.

instruction.text: Match the measurements given in metres and centimetres on the left to the measurements given just in centimetres on the right.

atoms.sound: 1 metre and 50 centimetres is as long as 150 cm.
3 metres and 77 centimetres is as long as 377 cm.
7 metres and 3 centimetres is as long as 703 cm.

hint.text: 1 kilometre is the same length as 1000 metres.

instruction.text: Match the measurements given in kilometres and metres on the left to the measurements given just in metres on the right.

atoms.sound: 1 km and 500 metres is as long as 1500 metres.
2 km and 305 metres is as long as 2305 metres.
3 km and 25 metres is as long as 3025 metres.

instruction.text: Connect the mixed length with the correct length on the right.
